entities.summary: Duncan Weir is a former Scotland international rugby union rugby player and now coach. He coaches at the Glasgow Warriors academy. He most recently played professional rugby for United Rugby Championship side Glasgow Warriors at fly-half. He previously played for Edinburgh and Worcester Warriors.
